title: Native Panel v1 binding
summary: Mount or destroy an existing native UI Panel by its immutable Core descriptor; no package renderer is imported.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No deadline. native-ui-panel surface and canonical native descriptor must match. Requires interaction.mount/update, ui.mount, no optional APIs and editable none. Validation mismatches use ValueError.

operations.name: invoke

context.description: Context whose app is exactly the bound application.

operations.notes: No deadline. Delegates mount/destroy to the bound trusted lifecycle; its full result/error and retry semantics depend on the embedding and remain unverified.

invariants.text: Only a context for the adapter's bound app can use its lifecycle.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.
